ResearcherNotesProject: Distinct from GEM's existing Chile rows and from the Colombia 'Andes Energy LNG Terminal' (T100000130960). FSRU-based import terminal in Atacama (Bahía Chasco), part of an integrated ~540 MW gas-fired power project. Consortium: Shell (gas supply), Mitsui O.S.K. Lines (FSRU provider/operator), Wärtsilä (power-generation engines); titular entity 'Andes S.A.'. RCA N°65/2019 (Atacama Env. Commission, 13-Jun-2019) approved; municipalities of Copiapó and Caldera challenged it; Supreme Court (Feb-2021) upheld their standing (procedural, did NOT overturn the RCA). The Committee of Ministers (Comité de Ministros) then REJECTED the project in June 2022 over ecosystem impacts (LatinFinance 08-Jun-2022, behind soft-block at staging time; corroborated by Mining Press/CodeXVerde). No revival reported since; entered here as cancelled (CancelledYear 2022). Capacity BLANKED on re-verification: the 1.5 mtpa figure was a GEM-internal m3/day->mtpa conversion not stated in any source; no off-GEM source (mundomaritimo, miningpress, codexverde, paiscircular, elciudadano, SEIA ficha) gives a regasification-capacity figure in any unit that verifies, so the value was dropped per the >=2-independent-source rule and Capacity [ref] left blank (no orphan ref). Sources describe only the 540 MW power plant. Capacity must be read off the SEIA EIA document itself before adding. Lat/long approximate (placeholder near Bahía Chasco) -- confirm against the SEIA georeferenced site before adding. Owner entities Shell PLC / Mitsui O.S.K. Lines Ltd already exist in GEM; Wärtsilä and 'Andes S.A.' (project SPV) are NOT in GEM and would need entity_lookup/addition if the row is added. ProposalYear 2014 from earliest SEIA submission; alternative 2016 (consortium-formalized EIA re-entry).
